# Version history

## v1.6.0

### General changes
- After collecting the main collectibles in a bonus room, the player is teleported back automatically instead of waiting for the timer to end.
- Ghost Luigis have been added for all 21 regular Power Stars.
- All boss cutscenes can now be skipped on recurring encounters with the respective boss.
- The Star List now displays the progress of the Comet Observatory.
- The "World 1" title is no longer displayed anywhere in the game since the mod only contains one world.
- Custom music received additional chord information.
- When collecting a Green Star, the player will be booted out only if there are any uncollected Green Stars left that can be reached without resetting or falling into death.
- Several dialogues and texts have been updated and cleaned up.
- Some locations now make use of better fitting lighting.
- Various internal adjustments were made to make things cleaner from a developer standpoint.
- Ice Bats can now be defeated by Co-Star Luma's Spin Attack.
- The pop-in of objects in various galaxies have been fixed.

### Cosmic Spirit intro
- The camera now ensures that the Cosmic Spirit is not covered by the message box.

### Starship Mario
- Lubba now informs the player about Co-Star mode.

### Galactic Garden Galaxy
- The vertical Cloud Flower and Space Junk block sections were slightly moved to improve the overall gameplay.
- The player gets booted out after collecting the second Green Star.

### Sweet Treat Galaxy
- The player no longer bumps against the floor when landing on the birthday cake planet.
- The brownish Li'l Cinder variant was removed in favor of the original enemy kind.
- Added a set of decorative balloons near the birthday cake planet.
- Various decorative background objects have been moved around.

### Gloomy Galleon Galaxy
- The underwater camera filter has been adjusted to make the view more clear.
- The four Gringills now appear during the Comet only in order to reduce lag.
- Reduced the number of algae to reduce lag.
- Generates Bubbles remain available for a longer duration now.
- The sandy platforms now show the player's footprints when walking on them.

### Battle Blast Galaxy
- The Stamp no longer appears during the Comet mission.

### Turnlog Galaxy

### Eep Beep Galaxy
- Sprangler Cocoons now have collision and reflect shot Star Bits.
- The player gets booted out after collecting any Green Star to prevent falling into death.
- The arrangement of beat blocks of the large stairway-like section has been adjusted to reduce the amount of time wasted on waiting.
- Added a small square platform in the penultimate section of the Comet mission to reduce frustration from wrong timing and depth perception.

### Kraken King Galaxy
- The Chance Cube's rotation has been fixed.
- Removed the death barrier between the airship and UFO sections, enabling a new shortcut.

### Comet Observatory
- In the second mission, the purple Luma was replaced with the Comet Luma from SMG1.
- Most books from the library room have been removed due to redundancy.
